## Why Partner?

University partnership gives your students a vetted, citation-ready data
source for coursework and dissertations, without your department having to
host or curate the datasets itself. Partnership is designed to be lightweight:

- **Endorse the terms.** Your institution reviews and signs off on the
  portal's data-use terms and citation standard.
- **Nominate a liaison.** A librarian, research office staff member, or
  department coordinator acts as your point of contact and can co-review
  student requests from your institution.
- **Promote to students.** Students use their university affiliation when
  requesting datasets, so requests can be routed and reported per institution.

## What Partnership Involves

| Step | Description |
|---|---|
| 1. Initial contact | Your research office or library reaches out (or is invited) to review the portal. |
| 2. Terms review | Legal/academic affairs reviews the data-use terms and citation policy. |
| 3. Liaison nomination | Your institution names a liaison to handle escalations and co-review requests. |
| 4. Logo & listing | Your university is added to the partner list and request-form dropdown. |
| 5. Ongoing reporting | *(Phase 2)* Partner dashboards showing request volume and turnaround per institution. |

## Interested in Partnering?

This is a proof of concept, so there is no live partnership process yet —
but if you'd like to discuss what a pilot could look like, reach out via the
[Contact](contact.html) page.
